title: [Feature request] Show balance change after command execution are done
body:
First of all - thanks for doing such an amazing product!

The only issue I have for now - its quite expensive some time. Any chances to add ability to show balance spending after end of the command execution? 

I keep refreshing page https://console.anthropic.com/settings/billing to get idea about price, which is pretty annoying :)
author: zhil
